description:
Flying out to the outer planets, the HUD speed readout just says 'NaN km/s' the whole way. Looks completely broken.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: What exactly went wrong? The attempted patch went to the right file and line but the tests still red. The operator needs to inspect what the specialist actually tried (which test failed, what error) to determine whether it was a subtle implementation error or a more fundamental issue.
A: I don't know.

Q: For outer-planet missions, the expected Hohmann transfer speeds at key waypoints (departure, mid-course, arrival) are not independently documented in the repo — they are derivable from vis-viva, but the acceptance criteria need a source for what 'correct' means beyond 'not NaN'.
A: I don't know.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: The patch text from the failed specialist attempt — what exactly was written at line 952? Without seeing the actual code change, I cannot tell whether the failure was a simple implementation error (wrong variable name, wrong formula structure) or a deeper issue (reactive scope, $derived not re-evaluating).
A: I don't know.

Q: The specific test failure — which test(s) failed, with what error message? The validation harness (fly-physics-validation.test.ts) and unit tests (fly-physics.test.ts) only cover Mars/Moon missions, so they wouldn't catch outer-planet NaN. Was this an e2e test failure? A build failure? A specific assertion message would diagnose the gap.
A: I don't know.
